    Description

    The Adidas Padel Racket World Cup Argentina 2026 is a shovel of Padel of Level Intermediate Designed for gamers who prioritize Control, stability and regularity in the game.

    Shape part of the special World Cup 2026 collection of Adidas, with a design inspired by the colors of the Argentine national team. Available along with the rest of Adidas Padel rackets in our store.

    Structural Reinforcement

    Perimeter reinforcements that increase resistance to twists generated during impact, providing greater structural stability and durability to the blade.

    Smart Holes Linear

    Arrangement of equidistant holes in groups of three that reinforces the impact surface, improves durability and optimizes pressure distribution in each blow.

    Fiberglass

    Face on Fiberglass which provides a soft touch, greater comfort and a fluid and controlled ball output in all types of shots.

    Technical specifications

    • Level: Intermediate
    • Face: Fiberglass (Fiberglass)
    • Weight: 360–375g (approx.)
    • Reinforcement: Perimeter Structural Reinforcement
    • Holes: Smart Holes Linear (groups of three equidistant)

    Design and features

    • Collection: World Cup 2026 — special edition Argentina
    • Colors: Inspired by the Argentine national team (light blue and White)
    • Game profile: Control and regularity from the bottom and in the Red
    • Manageability: Balanced behavior, easy to handle at all times

    Racket weight (select your weight)
    This racket weighs: 360-375g

    Manufacturer's weight: without grip, wrist strap or additional weights.
